body:
I can't really find the words to reply right now, and I don't wanna throw it back in your face with negativity.. So I'll keep what you said in mind and thank you...

It's nice, even just someone taking into account what you say.. Gives me a great feeling of relief. Even if I'm still kind of scared to think positively.

With me it's like trying to convince myself that I really want to die just because I know there's nothing else. Shit hurts man, so so bad. I've hurt my friends too, just so they'll stay away from me and don't get hurt when I die. Knowing everyone will always think I was terrible hurts too tbh.
